basic_info.description: Luxurious 11th floor one-bedroom with soaring 11' ceilings and expansive views through the floor to ceiling windows at The Beautiful Austin. Natural light is abundant in the living room that opens to a high-end kitchen with Miele & Bosch appliances. This home has central air conditioning, hardwood floors, spacious closets and custom window treatments with remote control (bedroom). The luxurious Spa like bath has an oversized walk-in shower, designer tiles and Hansgrohe fixtures. Austin is modern in efficiency and design. Amenities include designed lobby, roof-deck with panoramic views, doorman, outdoor garden lounge, pet spa and both bicycle and auto parking. Located in the heart of San Francisco Central to everything including multiple transportation options and Nob Hill, Pacific Heights and Polk Gulch shopping and restaurants.
